name: Planner - Goals
description: Plan goals together: each goal with its steps and how far along it is, dates optional.
author: Coffee Pub

provides.name: addGoal
provides.label: Add it as a goal
provides.description: Add a new goal to the plan.

inputHints.owners: Who owns it: keys or names as list_members shows them, separated by commas.
inputHints.object: A full description to add instead of the flat fields; its own words, day and phase are used.
inputHints.why: Why it matters. Line breaks are allowed.

provides.name: addStep
provides.label: Add a step to the goal
provides.description: Add a new step under a goal of the plan.

inputHints.goal: The goal it goes under, as a pointer; needed unless the description names the goal.
inputHints.object: A full description to add instead of the flat fields; details.under names the goal by title.

provides.name: addNote
provides.label: Add it as a note to the plan
provides.description: Add a note to the plan, under a goal if one is given.

inputHints.goal: The goal to put it under, as a pointer; leave it out for a note on the plan itself.
inputHints.object: A full description to add instead of the flat fields; its own words are used.
inputHints.text: The text. Line breaks are allowed.

provides.name: updateGoal
provides.label: Change a goal, step or note
provides.description: Change a goal, a step or a note in the plan, keeping what is not given.

inputHints.entry: The goal, step or note to change, as a pointer.
inputHints.why: Why it matters, for a goal. Send "" to clear it.
inputHints.date: The target day of a goal or the day of a step, as YYYY-MM-DD. Send "" to clear it.
inputHints.owners: Who owns a goal: keys or names as list_members shows them, separated by commas; this replaces the list. Send "" for none.
inputHints.text: A note's text. Line breaks are allowed. Send "" to clear it.
inputHints.goal: The goal a step or a note moves under, as a pointer; it goes to the end.

provides.name: setGoalDone
provides.label: Mark a goal or step done
provides.description: Mark a goal or a step done, or not done again.

inputHints.entry: The goal or step, as a pointer.
inputHints.done: True for done, false for not done. A goal whose progress is its steps is done when they all are.

settings.label: Dates
settings.help: Whether goals and steps show a date at all. Dates are never required.

settings.label: A goal's progress
settings.help: Steps: a goal is as far along as its steps that are done, and done when they all are. Done: a goal is ticked done or not.

settings.label: Open on
settings.help: The view you see first when you open the plan.
